focalCause.observed: Admin->Shopper first login held at HR authority gate for more than sixty seconds; one reload then displayed the correct shopper within about nineteen seconds.
focalCause.sourceRoot: backend-firebase.authContext preferred the cached initial principal over the current browser-auth principal after same-tab sign-out/sign-in; browser-auth could enter from the previous principal's CX_BACKEND_AUTHORIZED_STATE.
focalCause.securityImpactMitigated: Different Firebase UID/role/tenant/shopper/project snapshots must never be published as the new actor's authorized state.

pdfFinding.observed: Original seven-page PDF opened directly but embedded iframe appeared blank/black in both Admin and Shopper.
pdfFinding.correction: Render authorized PDF pages inside the module through PDF.js canvas, with page controls, clear loading/error status and original-link fallback.
